Team —

Quick, tactical note for the 15-minute sync at 11:00 PT today. Goal: lock down commit signals for any deals we plan to include in Friday's submission and escalate any blockers that would prevent turn-in. Please read the mini-checklist below and reply inline if you have any immediate asks.

TL;DR agenda (11:00 PT, 15 minutes):
- Quick signals: commit / upside / no-go (30s per deal)
- Blockers & owners (3m)
- Evidence status (who owns artifacts) (3m)
- Escalations we need Marissa to drive (2m)
- Confirm final list and owners for submission (remaining time)

Mini checklist before the call (please update thread):
- Add committed amount to the shared sheet (forecast-evidence.xlsx) — column G.
- Attachments: sales deck + contract redlines to Drive folder linked below.
- Security/compliance asks: list specific evidence required (SOC2 / retention / audit log samples).
- If procurement needs to route via legal procurement, flag now so Marissa can escalate.

Known deals I want us to cover first (put a short one-line state):
1) BrightLayer — legal redlines + retention question (owner: Priyom)
2) Acme Labs — PO timing unclear (owner: Neha)
3) Sandbox Retail — pricing pushback (owner: Marissa)

Attachments: forecast-evidence.xlsx (stub), account-asks.pdf (stub)
Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/BL-4627

If you cannot make 11:00, reply with a delegate and a one-line signal for each deal above.

Thanks,
Dylan
